method: Handwritten proofs plus exact rational/algebra checks and bounded abstract model exploration; not full C/Python formal verification.
path_convention: Manuscript/evidence links relative to this directory; experiments paths relative to repository root.

claims.statement: Chronological feature-row generation followed by QR preserves the complete feature likelihood.
assumptions: Fixed feature model; exact orthogonal arithmetic; disjoint source ownership
claims.optimization_authority: Exact basis or QR schedule changes subject to separate finite-precision bounds; no raw-input reordering.

claims.statement: The native tangent represents one full-prefix linearization with original prior once.
assumptions: Original whitened coordinates; prior rows [I,a]; refresh replaces tangent; successful kernels
claims.optimization_authority: Preserve joint quadratic and original prior; never recycle readout as independent evidence.

claims.statement: Ownership invariants hold over every finite admitted abstract trace.
assumptions: Elementary transitions obey commit/failure contracts; consumed and published boundaries distinct
claims.optimization_authority: Storage reuse only after all ordinary and recovery readers finish; partial source correspondence, not full program refinement.

claims.statement: Every Python field/backend exception leaves all live bytes unchanged.
claims.optimization_authority: None. Do not retry/checkpoint the partial field. Require transactional flush or backend quarantine proof.

claims.statement: Coefficient error maps exactly to centered likelihood, gradient and common-anchor GN precision errors.
assumptions: Same feature map and prior; symmetric Gram error
claims.optimization_authority: Budget error in joint geometry; parameter-independent cost removal still needs solver stopping equivalence.

assumptions: Same supported domain/base measure; proper finite normalizers; uniform oscillation bound
claims.optimization_authority: Derive compression tolerance from a declared mass-error budget; no H7-wide oscillation or tail bound yet.

claims.statement: Candidate interval mass transfers to an enlarged reference interval with at most the TV loss.
assumptions: Uniform query transport bound; common support; posterior mass bound
claims.optimization_authority: Separate transport and likelihood errors; does not validate local Gaussian or frequentist coverage.

claims.statement: Relative precision error epsilon<1 bounds covariance in every direction and changed-query SD.
assumptions: SPD reference precision; certified full matrix relative error and query-Jacobian error
claims.optimization_authority: All-direction local quadratic guarantee; scalar diagonal checks insufficient.

claims.statement: Reference gradient residual bounds parameter/query displacement in a strong-convexity metric.
assumptions: Reference Hessian lower bound throughout convex segment; interior reference minimizer; uniform query derivative bound
claims.optimization_authority: Convert representation and solver errors to practical query budget; GN precision alone does not prove convexity.

claims.statement: Residual/Jacobian defects and state-recurrence defects produce explicit accumulated errors.
assumptions: Declared exact residual model; affine recurrence for stated transport bound
claims.optimization_authority: No arbitrary forgetting; require excitation-dependent propagation and accumulation bounds.

claims.statement: Quiet data cannot uniformly identify Q; persistent bias defeats indefinite fixed-SD calibration; bounded nodes need not give bounded interpolant.
assumptions: Counterexample assumptions stated separately in manuscript
claims.optimization_authority: Require information, model-error and reachable-response premises; these are not evidence that the synthetic interpolant occurs in H7.

claims.statement: Five returned binary64 native factors satisfy an all-direction relative local precision bound.
assumptions: Supplied exact binary arrays; invertible supplied whitener certified by residual; positive reference bound; epsilon<1
claims.optimization_authority: Only these finite quadratics; feature generation, rounded query solves and future accumulation excluded.

claims.statement: Small entrywise factor changes can destroy precision in a weak joint direction.
assumptions: Synthetic severely correlated columns of scale1e10; same original rows; binary32 factor storage
claims.optimization_authority: No unqualified binary32 conversion. Scaling or certified mixed precision remains possible.

claims.statement: Uniform H7 physical feature, derivative and endpoint approximation bounds over admitted domain/horizon.
assumptions: Physical parameter/input domain, noise likelihood and horizon to be fixed
claims.optimization_authority: Required before probability-mass or practical accuracy certification for H7.

claims.statement: Full supported-horizon floating-point/refinement and exception-safety theorem.
assumptions: Ranges, conditioning, libm, solves, recurrence and all permitted errors bounded
claims.optimization_authority: Finite QR witnesses do not permit removing guards or assuming safe indefinite accumulation.

claims.statement: Validated population coverage and stimulus-supported estimation objectives.
assumptions: Versioned population and held-out independent endpoints; model/noise calibration
claims.optimization_authority: No truth coverage claim from local precision or correlated trace counts.

assumptions: Complete C port, target toolchain, liveness/stack and cycle measurement
claims.optimization_authority: Packed H7 factor alone50624B; no firmware-ready claim.
